jobs.description: At Bavaria, we are looking for enthusiastic forklift drivers to strengthen our logistics team! In this full-time position, you will be an essential link in ensuring our logistics processes run smoothly. Would you like to work for one of the world's most iconic beer brands and be part of a strong family-owned company? Then keep reading! What will you do?In the Bavaria Bottling Department, we are looking for forklift drivers who are eager to work in a 5-shift operation. As a forklift driver, you will be responsible for various tasks within Bavaria's production process. Your duties include:- Transporting empty cans to the production line using a forklift.- Ensuring that colleagues in the next department always have sufficient stock available to fill the cans.- Maintaining a clean, organized, and safe work area.- Working together with colleagues to ensure the production process runs smoothly.Variety is a key part of this role: you will not only work as a forklift driver, but also support the production process as an operator on a modern production line. This makes the position diverse and gives you significant responsibility within the production process.Working Hours & AvailabilityUntil December 2026, work will be performed in a 3-shift schedule:You will work according to a fixed three-week rotating schedule:- Week 1: 4 to 5 night shifts from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM- Week 2: 3 afternoon shifts from 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM and 2 morning shifts from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM- Week 3: 3 morning shifts from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM and 2 afternoon shifts from 2:00 PM to 10:00 PMFrom January 2027, we will transition to a 5-shift schedule:- 2 morning shifts from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM- 2 afternoon shifts from 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM- 2 night shifts from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM- 4 days off- You are in possession of a valid forklift certificate;- You are fluent in either Dutch or English;- You are willing to work in shift patterns, including day shifts.

Warehouse order picker/HLO - Den Hoorn -  €15.29 per uur - Logistics - 36 hour Do you want to work as an HLO (Man Up) Orderpicker at the major logistics company Van der Helm? The job is performed using a tall Combi Truck. The worker sits inside the cabin of the machine. The cabin is large enough to provide the worker with space to sit and move safely. The machine can reach significant heights, up to 12-16 meters. The worker ascends together with the cabin. Before ascending, the worker places an empty pallet on the forks. Occasionally, there is a full pallet on the forks if it needs to be placed in the rack. When you are high in the air, you pick boxes from the shelves by hand. The boxes can weigh between 15 and 20 kilos, depending on the product. The worker puts the boxes on the empty pallet or places full pallets into the rack. After finishing the work, the machine goes down. The worker drives the truck to another place in the warehouse.
